primary_rule.substantive_link_definition: intersection_area / min(UCDB_area, YCEO_cluster_area) >= 0.5 (the 1005-7 link definition, unchanged)
primary_rule.metric: sum(intersection_m2 over linked UCDB centres) / yceo_cluster_area_m2 (identical to 1005-7's cluster_ucdb_coverage)
primary_rule.single_city_clusters: kept as-is; S/H equal the single linked UCDB centre's values
primary_rule.multi_city_clusters: kept iff star-shaped (every linked UCDB centre links to no other cluster) and single-country; S summed, H = sum(B_i(t))/sum(B_i(T)) (Section 10)
primary_rule.one_ucdb_to_multiple_yceo: excluded (status=ambiguous_nonstar) -- a UCDB centre may not contribute to more than one cluster's outcome
primary_rule.missing_R: excluded (status=invalid_R); validity only, magnitude never used
primary_rule.qc_exclusions: inherits the 1005-4 Gate-1 sample (YOB<=2020, N=10,915) before any crosswalk step

geometry_sensitivities.name: S1_looser_coverage_040
geometry_sensitivities.purpose: lower bound on N / looser footprint requirement

geometry_sensitivities.name: S3_drop_iou_floor
geometry_sensitivities.purpose: isolates the effect of the added IoU condition from the coverage threshold

non_geometry_sensitivities_preregistered: dominant-city H substitution for multi-city units (Section 11)
